_about: Every word in the combat sandbox UI (scripts/ui/sandbox/). {n}, {value}, {path} and similar words in braces are filled in by the code. Names such as Lamp Flare and the Noise rank names are working names (Level 1): change them here, no code needed. The knob hints below are a fallback: a knob's own "hint" in data/combat/feel.json wins.

hints.reset: Put Red, the enemies and your Noise back at the start.
hints.controls: See every button, and change them.

controls_card.title: Controls
controls_card.lock_note: Lock on: tap again to let go. Flick to switch.

feel.title: Feel Knobs
feel.move_hint: Up/Down picks a knob. Left/Right changes it. Hold to go faster. Cancel closes.

button_hints.save: Write your numbers to a file you can send back. Also keeps a dated copy.
button_hints.reset: Put every knob back to the studio's starting numbers. Not saved until you Save.
button_hints.revert: Undo everything since your last Save.
button_hints.open_folder: Open the folder where the saved files live.

messages.save_failed: Could not save. Is the disk full or locked?
messages.reset_done: Every knob is back to the studio number.
messages.revert_nothing: Nothing to undo since the last save.
messages.folder_failed: Could not open the folder. It is here: {path}

knob_hints.run_speed_mps: How fast Red runs with the stick pushed all the way.
knob_hints.jump_height_m: How high a full jump goes.
knob_hints.gravity_scale: How hard gravity pulls. Lower floats more, higher drops faster.
knob_hints.dash_distance_m: How far one dash carries Red.
knob_hints.dash_time_ms: How long a dash takes. Shorter feels snappier.
knob_hints.dash_iframes_ms: How long at the start of a dash Red can't be hit.
knob_hints.air_dash_count: How many dashes Red gets in the air per jump.
knob_hints.cam_distance_m: How far behind Red the camera sits.
knob_hints.cam_sensitivity: How fast the mouse and right stick turn the camera.
knob_hints.hit_stop_scale: An extra multiplier on every hit freeze, on top of Hit freeze length (Hit feel tab). Leave at 1 and use Hit feel instead. 0 turns the freeze off.
knob_hints.juggle_float: How long enemies hang in the air between hits.
knob_hints.launch_height_scale: How high the launcher throws an enemy.
knob_hints.input_buffer_ms: How early you can press the next button and still have it count.
knob_hints.parry_window_scale: Makes the parry timing window bigger or smaller.
knob_hints.enemy_damage_scale: How hard enemies hit you. 0 means they can't hurt you.
knob_hints.flare_duration_s: How long the Lamp Flare slow-motion lasts.
knob_hints.flare_cooldown_s: How long you wait before another Lamp Flare can start.
knob_hints.flare_enemy_speed: How fast enemies move in a flare. 0.25 is quarter speed.
knob_hints.perfect_dodge_window_ms: How close to the hit a dash must be to count as a perfect dodge.
knob_hints.flare_glare_radius_m: How far the flare reaches. Enemies inside it slow down.
knob_hints.shake_scale: How hard the camera shakes on hits. 0 turns it off.
knob_hints.enemies_attack: Turn this off to practice on enemies that don't hit back.
knob_hints.show_hitboxes: Draw the attack and hurt shapes so you can see them.
knob_hints.launcher_input: Which button press sends an enemy flying up.
knob_hints.lights_on_trigger: How Lights On starts when your Noise is full.
knob_hints.flare_on_parry: Which parries set off a Lamp Flare.

launcher_input.hold_heavy: Press Heavy and keep holding it: it turns into the launcher.
launcher_input.back_heavy: Pull the stick away from the enemy and press Heavy.
launcher_input.string_end: Press Heavy right after the second Light.

lights_on_trigger.auto: Lights On starts by itself the moment Noise is full.
lights_on_trigger.chord: When Noise is full, press Light and Heavy together to start it.

flare_on_parry.rad_and_up: Rad and Totally Rad parries start a flare.
flare_on_parry.perfect_only: Only a Totally Rad parry starts a flare.
flare_on_parry.off: Parries never start a flare. Only dodges do.

hack_pick_mode.pick_then_fire: Choose a hack with d-pad left/right (keys 1 to 4), then press the hack button to fire it.
hack_pick_mode.automatic: The hack button picks for you by what is around Red. Hold it to Reboot.
